items.description: Floor cleaning, connection check, skirting replacement utility room and hallway
items.rationale: Escape of water from washing machine hose (2.4.2(a)) covered; cleaning of affected surfaces 7.1.7(h), source check 7.1.7(e), skirting replacement as affected trim. Fair combined market price.

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying utility room and hallway
items.rationale: 7.1.7(b) covers moisture measurement and drying of affected rooms incl. equipment hire; both rooms were affected.

items.description: Assessment and drying of framed decorative print
items.rationale: Mass-produced poster print is household contents (4.3(d)), not an item of particular value under 5.2.6; buildings-only policy, so not covered.
